2292-6277-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2511-3240-6462-8347.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Sela triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1420-2178-5686.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
1420-2178-5686.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

2033-4687-5115.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least four counters on it.
2033-4687-5115.description:
Activate Citanul Hierophants by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Gemstone Array, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

728-2459-4053-6989.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

2557-4772-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3062-3099-4762-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson and Pir.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1368-3755-6321-7060.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3755-6321-7060.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

341-4499-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

1445-4871-5147-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5147-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2438-3817-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-2208-6441.description:
Activate Charming Scoundrel by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Charming Scoundrel enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Charming Scoundrel.
Resolve the Charming Scoundrel trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-1251-4846-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1251-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1978-5056-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
1978-5056-5614.description:
Cause Bighorner Rancher to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Repeat from step 2.

1778-2173-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1251-4947-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

394-856-5231-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

147-5686-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1003-1329-2178-3967.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2178-3967.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2292-4053--73.notablePrerequisites: If a persist creature is used, it does not have a -1/-1 counter on it. Otherwise, if an undying creature is used, it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2292-4053--73.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

411-1283-3676.description:
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {3}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {1} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2350-3682-4518-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Kor Skyfisher from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

116-5329-5475.description:
Activate either of the creatures by tapping it, targeting the other creature.
If the tapped creature was a Merfolk, Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, untapping the targeted creature.
Repeat.

2082-2438-3197.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Herd Baloth.
2082-2438-3197.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2082-2438-3197.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3490-5231-5445.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to any creature you control.
3490-5231-5445.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing any creature except the one with Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

225-1021-1315-2953.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Dawn's Reflection attached to any mana-producing land you control.
225-1021-1315-2953.description:
Activate the land with Dawn's Reflection attached by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Dawn's Reflection triggers, adding {2}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1063-1633-2060-4086-4120.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Oskar triggers if the discarded card was a nonland card.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler;s first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Oskar trigger, choosing to cast Hanabi Blast if it was the discarded card by paying {1}{R}{R} targeting Crystalline Crawler, or choosing not to cast the card otherwise.
If you did not cast Hanabi Blast using Oskar, cast it from your hand by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

1284-4136-4831-5077-5235.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Scaretiller.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
1284-4136-4831-5077-5235.description:
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, targeting Cacophodon.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Brokers Hideout from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Brokers Hideout enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Roaring Earth.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cacophodon.
Resolve the Brokers Hideout trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for a basic Plains, Island or Forest and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Roaring Earth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Scaretiller ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to Cacophodon.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

2554-3923-4659-5195.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Third Path Iconoclast and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Third Path Iconoclast trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier artifact creature token.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return it to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1520-3259-4314-4359.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to Pawn of Ulamog.
You control an additional nontoken Vampire.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1520-3259-4314-4359.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Pawn of Ulamog.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice Pawn of Ulamog, attach Breath of Fury to another nontoken Vampire you control, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Pawn of Ulamog dies, triggering itself and Timothar.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Timothar trigger, causing you to pay {1} and exile Pawn of Ulamog to create a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, as well as the Bat token.
The Bat and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Bat's trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and return Pawn of Ulamog from exile to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, attach Breath of Fury to Pawn of Ulamog, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
The Vampire dies, triggering Pawn of Ulamog and Timothar.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Timothar trigger, causing you to pay {1} and exile the Vampire to create a 1/1 Bat creature token.
 Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage to an opponent using Pawn of Ulamog and the Bat token.
The Bat and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Bat's trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and return the Vampire from exile to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice Pawn of Ulamog, attach Breath of Fury to another nontoken Vampire you control, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

1734-3913-5147.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, exiling Crypt Champion.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, returning Crypt Champion from exile to the battlefield.
Crypt Champion enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Resolve the first Crypt Champion trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have a large amount of Goblin Bombardment triggers, you may stop the loop and deal infinite damage to any target(s).

141-1922.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Blur.
141-1922.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Blur, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Blur, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

1268-1278-4508.notablePrerequisites:
Crab Umbra attached to Lightning-Rig Crew.
Lightning-Rig Crew does not have summoning sickness.
1268-1278-4508.description:
Tap Lightning-Rig Crew to deal 1 damage to each opponent, creating 3 treasure tokens from Malcolm's trigger.
Sacrifice 3 treasure token for {2}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra to untap Lightning-Rig Crew.
Repeat.

618-2816-4287-5313.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Kiki-Jiki.
At least nine additional creatures in your graveyard.
618-2816-4287-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Kraul Foragers with haste.
The token enters gaining you 9 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

2018-2363-4053.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.
2018-2363-4053.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
